evidence: Blanes–Iserles–Macnamara discuss general barriers but not all-stage cube-specific signs. Banjai–Ferrari analyze convolution quadrature instead of entrywise graph kernels. Previously reported cycle, strongly regular and multipartite graph formulas have different graph-domain hypotheses.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The 3-cube has degree 3 and 8 vertices, is not a cycle, is not complete multipartite and is not strongly regular because distance-two pairs have two common neighbors while antipodes have none. Thus those classifications do not cover it even by a simple parameter change. The broad RK order barrier only asserts impossibility of uniform positivity over all generators, not the explicit cube boundary.
